name: Desmios
source:
Half-beast Sara lives in a village deep in the forest. She spends days peacefully on fresh air with her lover. But one day she gets captured and is tortured by countless humans and strange creatures...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
半兽萨拉住在森林深处的一个村庄里。她和爱人一起在新鲜空气中平静地度过了几天。但有一天，她被抓获，并受到无数人类和奇异生物的折磨……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
